sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.2
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The December 11, 2025 release explicitly maps GPT-5.2 Thinking to the gpt-5.2 API alias, separately from Instant/chat-latest and Pro. Its capability, training-infrastructure and benchmark sections provide no nominal total or active parameter count.

sources.title: GPT-5.2 API model documentation
sources.evidence: Re-fetched official documentation and reread the fresh full Markdown on October 27, 2026. Binds gpt-5.2 to gpt-5.2-2025-12-11; gives 400,000 context and 128,000 maximum output, text/image inputs, text output, reasoning tokens, none/low/medium/high/xhigh effort, function calling, file uploads, prompt caching and Responses/Chat Completions. No numerical total/active model parameter specification is present. No deprecated or shut-down status is shown.

sources.title: Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2
sources.evidence: Re-read the original December 11, 2025 PDF from its October 27, 2026 HTTP-200 primary-source fetch, including section 2 and full-text parameter/architecture searches. Distinguishes Thinking from Instant and describes reinforcement-learning reasoning training. It supplies neither a nominal total nor a nominal active parameter count or named base with a published size.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Directly fetched technical guide expressly applies to models before GPT-5.6. Explains OpenAI caching through Transformer attention key/value projections and names gpt-5.2 in its model table. Exact-model caching support plus this mechanism permits a qualified broad Transformer inference.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Directly fetched guide specifies Responses PDF processing into text and page images for vision-capable models; Chat Completions also accepts PDF file content. Supports PDF as an API format, not a separate native model modality.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.4
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The March 5, 2026 successor announcement has exact GPT-5.2 comparison columns for work, coding, vision, tools, context and reasoning. These report performance; its API-parameter discussion is not a weight count. No GPT-5.2 total/active count is stated.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card
sources.evidence: Re-read the fresh October 27, 2026 HTTP-200 original PDF, including training, predecessor identification and full-text count searches. The March 5, 2026 card explicitly uses GPT-5.2 Thinking as a baseline; its exact-model safety and monitorability comparisons contain no nominal total or active parameter specification. Later-model training details are not transferred.

sources.title: Reasoning Models Struggle to Control their Chains of Thought
sources.evidence: Re-read the original PDF from its October 27, 2026 HTTP-200 fetch. Figure 1b and the size analyses use GPT-OSS 20B/120B and Qwen3 14B/32B; Figure 1c varies GPT-5.2 reasoning length, not parameter size. The RL scaling intervention uses OLMo. None of these numbers establishes a GPT-5.2 total or active count.

sources.title: Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2 — updated online card
sources.evidence: Reopened the updated online card on October 27, 2026. Read Model Data and Training and searched its full text for parameter disclosures. Its training discussion and later GPT-5.2 Thinking CoT analyses publish no nominal total or active model parameter count.

sources.title: API deprecations
sources.evidence: Directly fetched complete deprecation list. No exact gpt-5.2 or gpt-5.2-2025-12-11 shutdown notice found at review. GPT-5.2 Chat and Codex have distinct notices that do not apply to this Thinking API record. This is documentation evidence, not an endpoint test.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Section 9.1 reserves service IP rights and grants limited use rather than ownership. Used as descriptive proprietary hosted-service classification, not a named downloadable-weight license or an assertion about exact launch-day contract wording.

sources.title: All OpenAI API models
sources.evidence: Direct current catalog lists GPT-5.2 as a previous flagship, without the shutdown labels applied to Chat and Codex. Separately identifies Apache-2.0 open-weight gpt-oss releases; no GPT-5.2 weight distribution is offered.

sources.title: Investigating the consequences of accidentally grading CoT during RL
sources.evidence: May 7, 2026 training-research lead inspected. It identifies GPT-5.2 Instant among affected models, not this GPT-5.2 Thinking API variant. Its variant-specific training statements are not transferred; it supplies no Thinking parameter count or architecture.

sources.title: Step 3.5 Flash: Open Frontier-Level Intelligence with 11B Active Parameters — Table 5
sources.evidence: Freshly opened October 27, 2026 after targeted searches for GPT-5.2 total, active and activated parameter counts. Table 5 explicitly identifies GPT-5.2 xHigh and separately labels Activated params and Total params; both cells are dashes. This original model-team comparison provides no GPT-5.2 size convention. Its Step 3.5 Flash and other open-model counts do not transfer. Searches of official OpenAI disclosures and later original research found no supported nominal GPT-5.2 count; black-box capacity estimates were excluded.

name.note: Official API name; launch explicitly identifies this alias with GPT-5.2 Thinking.

developer.note: Developer identified by the first-party release and authored system card.

family.note: GPT-5.2 release family, within the wider GPT-5 series; distinct from Instant, Pro and Codex variants.

release_date.note: Dated original announcement explicitly releases Thinking in ChatGPT and the API that day; does not rely solely on the snapshot suffix.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is hosted ChatGPT/API access under retained service rights; the publisher separately identifies its downloadable open-weight models.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model, not an SPDX checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: No published nominal total count found in the fresh original-release, system-card, API and later research checks. StepFun Table 5 leaves the exact GPT-5.2 xHigh total cell blank. No named base with a disclosed size supports a lineage inference; black-box estimates and sibling sizes are not specifications.

active_parameters_b.note: No published nominal active count found for GPT-5.2 Thinking. StepFun Table 5 explicitly leaves its GPT-5.2 xHigh Activated params cell blank. Reasoning effort/length measures test-time compute, not activated weights; no dense-total equality or sibling transfer is inferred.

architecture.note: Qualified cross-source operational inference: exact GPT-5.2 supports prompt_caching and the applicable technical guide names it while explaining Transformer-layer attention KV tensors. This does not establish exclusively Transformer blocks, a complete layer inventory, dense/MoE routing, dimensions or parameter counts.

context_window.note: Exact API documentation gives 400,000 context separately from 128,000 maximum output. No input maximum is stated; none is derived by subtraction or borrowed from ChatGPT product limits.

modalities.note: Native inputs are text/image and output is text. PDF denotes supported API preprocessing into text and page images for this vision/file-upload model; tool-generated images and video benchmarks do not establish native image/video output.

reasoning.note: Explicit Thinking identity and reasoning-token support. Configurable effort includes none (default), low, medium, high and xhigh; default none does not mean the model lacks reasoning support.

tool_call.note: Exact API documentation explicitly supports function calling and Responses tools.

description.value: GPT-5.2 reasoning model with text and image input, function calling and a 400,000-token context window.
description.note: Replaces subjective baseline positioning with documented capabilities of this exact Thinking API model.

patch.notes: The gpt-5.2 API alias maps to GPT-5.2 Thinking and documents default snapshot gpt-5.2-2025-12-11, distinct from Instant/chat-latest, Pro and Codex. Context is 400,000 tokens with a separate 128,000 maximum output; no maximum input is stated on the exact model page. Reasoning effort supports none (default), low, medium, high and xhigh. PDF denotes API extraction into text and page images. Transformer is a qualified operational inference from exact prompt-caching support and the applicable Transformer attention KV mechanism; complete block design and dense/MoE routing remain undisclosed. No published nominal total or active parameter count was found for GPT-5.2 Thinking; StepFun's comparison table leaves both GPT-5.2 xHigh counts blank. As of October 27, 2026, the exact API model page has no deprecated/shut-down designation and the reviewed deprecation list has no shutdown notice for this alias or dated snapshot; Chat and Codex retirement notices are separate. No endpoint test was made.

summary: Confirmed December 11, 2025 Thinking/API release, 400K context, configurable reasoning and tool calling; preserves all twelve non-parameter assessments. The October 27 parameter re-audit reopened the original release, system card, API documentation and later OpenAI research, then searched total and active counts separately. No supported nominal count or count-bearing named lineage was found; StepFun Table 5 explicitly leaves both GPT-5.2 xHigh counts blank. Both counts remain undisclosed with explicit null patches; no black-box estimates or sibling counts are adopted.
